senses.why: The route sense is compressed into a modifier: a road whose whole job is to give access.
senses.whyCN: 「路线」这一义被压缩成修饰语：一条存在意义就是提供通行的路。

intro.en: Access comes from a Latin verb of going, and the noun still keeps the shape of a doorway.
intro.cn: access 来自一个表示「走」的拉丁语动词，名词至今仍保留「门口」的形状。

items.en: The verb cedere meant 'to go, move, yield'. Its earlier origin is uncertain.
items.cn: 动词 cedere 意为「走、移动、让出」；更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Ad- 'to' plus cedere formed accedere, 'to come near, approach; to be added'.
items.cn: ad-「向」加 cedere 构成 accedere，意为「走近、接近；附加」。

items.en: The noun accessus meant 'a coming near, an entrance', and also 'an increase'.
items.cn: 名词 accessus 意为「接近、入口」，同时也有「增加」之义。

items.en: Old French acces brought the noun into English in the fourteenth century with the senses of approach and entrance.
items.cn: 古法语 acces 在十四世纪把这个名词带入英语，带有「接近」与「入口」两义。

items.en: The verb is much later and is generally dated to the twentieth century; the computing sense grew with the computer.
items.cn: 动词用法晚得多，一般追溯到二十世纪；计算机「存取数据」义随电脑普及而发展。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin root of going and reaching; the near-meaning group names ways of entering or being admitted.
note.cn: 形近组共享表示「走、抵达」的拉丁词根；近义组列出「进入」与「获准进入」的各种说法。

entries.definition: Able to be reached, entered, or used, also used of places designed for disabled people.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可到达的、可使用的」，也指为残障人士设计的无障碍场所。

entries.definition: The noun for how easy something is to reach or use.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「可达性、无障碍程度」，指某处或某物被到达和使用的容易程度。

entries.definition: Too far, too difficult, or too locked to be reached.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「难以到达的、难以理解的」，是 accessible 加否定前缀构成的反义形式。

entries.definition: The act of taking up an office or of joining a group, from the same Latin verb.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「就职、加入、新增」，来自同一个拉丁语动词。

entries.definition: The door or opening by which you enter, more physical than access.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「入口、门口」，比 access 更强调具体的门或开口。

entries.definition: The act of going in, or the right to go in, often in official contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「进入、入场权」，常用于较正式的语境。

entries.definition: Permission to enter a place or join an institution, often after a check.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「准许进入、录取」，通常需要经过查验或审核。

entries.definition: The act of coming near, or a way of dealing with something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「接近、途径」，也可指处理问题的方法。

entries.definition: To arrive at or stretch out to something, with no idea of permission.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「到达、伸手够到」，不含「获准」的意思。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb of going and the everyday phrases built on access.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁语「走」动词，以及由 access 构成的日常搭配。

normal.en: cedere is to go: access is the going up to a place.
normal.cn: cedere 是「走」：access 就是朝某处走过去。

normal.en: Accedere adds ad- 'to', so the word always points at a destination.
normal.cn: accedere 加了 ad-「向」，所以这个词总是指向一个目的地。

normal.en: Access to a place is a route; access to a thing is a right.
normal.cn: access to a place 是路线，access to a thing 则是权利。

normal.en: An access code is the modern key to the old door.
normal.cn: access code 就是开那扇老门的新式钥匙。

normal.en: The verb keeps the same shape: access a file, access a building.
normal.cn: 动词形式完全一样：access a file 是访问文件，access a building 是进入大楼。

abstract.en: A door, a key, and a hand on the handle: permission is only a route that stayed open.
abstract.cn: 一扇门、一把钥匙、一只搭在门把上的手：许可不过是一条没有关上的路。

abstract.en: The same word covers a garden gate and a folder on a screen, because both stand between you and what you want.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指花园小门，也指屏幕上的文件夹，因为两者都挡在你和想要的东西之间。

abstract.en: Access is never the thing itself; it is the thin passage that leads to it.
abstract.cn: access 从来不是东西本身，它只是通向那件东西的细窄通道。

examples.en: Students have free access to the online library.
examples.cn: 学生可以免费使用在线图书馆。

examples.en: You can access your files from any device.
examples.cn: 你可以从任何设备访问自己的文件。

examples.en: The rear door gives access to the garden.
examples.cn: 后门通向花园。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「艾克塞斯」——走到门口，门恰好开了：能走进去就是 access。

root: 拉丁语 accessus「接近、入口」来自 accedere「走近」，由 ad-「向」加 cedere「走、让」构成；更早的词源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Access starts as a physical way in and spreads to permission, to networks, to stored data, and even to a feeling that suddenly comes over a person.
sensesIntro.cn: access 从一条实在的进门之路出发，扩展到许可、网络、存储的数据，甚至扩展到突然扑上心头的情绪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked side door; a key turns and the way in appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇锁着的侧门，钥匙一转，进去的路出现了。

branches.en: THE DOOR: a route into a place, and the act of walking through it.
branches.cn: 门口线：进入某处的路线，以及穿过去的动作。

branches.en: THE RIGHT: an open route becomes a permission, and the permission becomes an act.
branches.cn: 权利线：敞开的路线变成许可，许可又变成一次具体的进入。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: a network and its stored files are reached the way a room is reached.
branches.cn: 系统线：网络与其中存储的文件，都按走进房间的方式来抵达。

branches.en: THE ONSET: an emotion arrives and enters a person, an old literary branch.
branches.cn: 发作线：情绪来临并进入一个人，这是古老的文学分支。

branches.en: THE MODIFIER: the route sense shrinks into a word placed before a noun.
branches.cn: 定语线：路线义缩小成一个放在名词前的修饰词。

intro.en: Access is a Latin noun of motion, and English builds its family with suffixes rather than new roots.
intro.cn: access 是一个表示运动的拉丁语名词，英语靠后缀而不是新词根扩展它的词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb cedere, its compound accedere and the noun accessus are all recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 cedere、它的复合形式 accedere 与名词 accessus 均有文献记录。

items.meaning: a coming near, a way in
items.exampleCN: 只有工作人员可以进入。

items.example: The variant appears in process and access.
items.exampleCN: 这个变体出现在 process 与 access 中。

derivatives.zh: 可到达的；可使用的；易懂的
难以到达的；难以理解的

definition_zh: 进口；引进；输入；（名词）进口品
definition_en: to bring goods into a country from abroad, or goods brought in this way
core_image: 码头上一排排从船腹里吊出来的集装箱
scene: 港口每天清早最忙，吊车一刻不停。 The country imports most of its oil, so every delay on the shipping route is felt at the pumps.
sceneCN: 这里 import 是「进口」（第 1 个义项：把货物从国外运入本国），句意是这个国家的石油大多靠进口，因此航线上任何延误都会在加油站被感受到。画面里有码头上被吊起的集装箱。

collocations.zh: 这一信息的分量（引申义）

senses.title: To bring goods in from abroad
senses.definition: to buy and bring goods into one's own country
senses.definitionCN: 从国外购入并把货物运入本国
senses.example: The factory imports steel from three countries.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂从三个国家进口钢材。
senses.why: The prefix means into and the root means carry, so import is literally to carry in.
senses.whyCN: 前缀意为「向内」，词根意为「搬运」，所以 import 字面就是「向内搬运」。

senses.title: A good brought in
senses.definition: the goods or services brought into a country this way
senses.definitionCN: 以这种方式进入本国的货物或服务
senses.example: Imports rose sharply last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年进口额大幅上升。
senses.why: The action and its object share one form in English, so the noun simply names what the verb brings.
senses.whyCN: 英语里动作与对象常共用一个形式，名词就直接指动词带进来的东西。

senses.title: The meaning or weight of words
senses.definition: the significance carried by a statement or event, a formal use
senses.definitionCN: 言语或事件所承载的意义，属正式用法
senses.example: Few understood the import of his words.
senses.exampleCN: 很少有人听懂他话里的分量。
senses.why: To carry is not only to move boxes; words and events carry meaning, and the old verb kept that freight sense.
senses.whyCN: 搬运不只运箱子，词与事件也承载意义，这个旧动词保留了这份「载重」之意。

intro.en: Import is a Latin verb for carrying in, and its shipping sense has survived unchanged for centuries.
intro.cn: import 是拉丁语「搬入」动词，其航运本义历经数百年未变。

items.en: Portare meant to carry, and importare meant to carry in or bring in.
items.cn: 拉丁语 portare 意为搬运，importare 意为搬入、带入。

items.en: Trade Latin used importare for bringing goods into a province or a city.
items.cn: 商业用的拉丁语以 importare 指把货物运入行省或城市。

items.en: English took import at first for bringing in goods, and also for bringing in ideas.
items.cn: 英语最初用 import 指运入货物，也指引入观念。

items.en: Nation states and customs houses made import a fixed term of trade and duty.
items.cn: 民族国家与海关把 import 定为贸易与关税的固定术语。

items.en: The formal sense of weight or meaning kept the old freight metaphor alive.
items.cn: 表示「分量、含义」的正式用法让古老的「载重」比喻得以延续。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers carry-root words; the near-meaning group gathers trade words and their opposites.
note.cn: 形近组收「搬运」词根的词；近义组收贸易词及其对立词。

entries.definition: To carry goods out, the exact mirror of import.
entries.definitionCN: 把货运出去，正是 import 的镜像。

entries.definition: Easy to carry, from the same carrying root.
entries.definitionCN: 便于携带的，同出「搬运」之根。

entries.definition: Of great weight, built on the same freight idea.
entries.definitionCN: 很有分量的，同出「载重」之意。

entries.definition: The plain everyday phrase for importing.
entries.definitionCN: 进口的朴素日常说法。

entries.definition: To bring something in for the first time, often ideas.
entries.definitionCN: 首次引进，多指观念。

entries.definition: A load of goods sent, whether in or out.
entries.definitionCN: 运送的一批货，进出皆可。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the carry root, the in-out pair, and the freight of meaning.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用上「搬运」词根、进出对立，以及意义的载重。

normal.en: Im- in, port carry: to carry in, and export is to carry out.
normal.cn: im- 向内，port 搬运：向内搬，而 export 是向外搬。

normal.en: The noun and verb look alike; the verb often stresses the second beat: im-PORT.
normal.cn: 名词动词同形；动词常重读第二拍：im-PORT。

normal.en: Port is also a harbour, where everything carried in arrives.
normal.cn: port 也是港口，正是向内搬运之物抵达之处。

normal.en: Important and import share the idea of weight carried.
normal.cn: important 与 import 共享「所载之重」这一意象。

normal.en: Imports come in, exports go out, and the e in export points outward.
normal.cn: imports 进、exports 出，export 的 e 指向外面。

abstract.en: Trade makes the word ordinary, but it began as pure carrying, and boxes and meanings both travel.
abstract.cn: 贸易让这个词变得平常，但它本只是搬运，箱子与意义都在旅途中。

abstract.en: A country that imports depends on ships it does not control.
abstract.cn: 进口国所依赖的船，未必由自己掌舵。

abstract.en: The formal sense reminds us that a sentence can carry freight too heavy for a careless listener.
abstract.cn: 那个正式义提醒我们：一个句子所载之重，粗心的听者扛不动。

examples.en: Britain imports much of its fruit from warmer countries.
examples.cn: 英国的水果大多从较温暖的国家进口。

examples.en: The tariff raised the price of imported cars.
examples.cn: 关税提高了进口汽车的价格。

examples.en: He spoke slowly, as if weighing the import of each word.
examples.cn: 他说得很慢，仿佛在掂量每个字的分量。

dict_mnemonic.text: im 向内 + port 搬（港口）——往本国港口搬货：进口；引申为含义所承载的分量

root: 拉丁语 portare「搬运」加向内前缀 in- 成 importare「搬入」，中世纪进入英语，近代定为贸易术语「进口」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: bringing goods in, the goods themselves, and the weight of a statement.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：把货运进来、所运进来的货物，以及话语所承载的分量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: container boxes lifted out of a ship at dawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：清晨从船腹吊出的集装箱。

branches.en: THE TRADE LINE: countries buy what they cannot produce.
branches.cn: 贸易线：国家购买自己产不出的东西。

branches.en: THE STATISTIC LINE: imports appear in every trade report.
branches.cn: 统计线：进口额出现在每份贸易报告里。

branches.en: THE LANGUAGE LINE: old prose still speaks of the import of words.
branches.cn: 语言线：旧体文章中仍说 the import of words。

branches.en: THE PORT LINE: harbours are where the verb and noun meet.
branches.cn: 港口线：港口正是动词与名词相遇之地。

branches.en: THE WEIGHT LINE: goods and words both arrive loaded.
branches.cn: 载重线：货物与语言都是载着重物抵达的。

intro.en: Import is a directional prefix on the Latin carrying root, with a mirror form in export.
intro.cn: import 是方向前缀加拉丁语搬运词根，export 是其镜像。

latinIntro.en: Portare and importare are recorded in Latin, and the root also builds portable and transport.
latinIntro.cn: portare 与 importare 均有拉丁文献，词根还造出 portable 与 transport。

items.example: Immigrant uses the same inward sense.
items.exampleCN: immigrant 也带同一向内之意。
transport 与 portable 共用此根。

items.meaning: to carry in; goods carried in

items.example: The firm began importing last spring.
items.exampleCN: 这家公司去年春天开始进口。

definition_zh: 名录；目录；文件夹
definition_en: a list of names, addresses or files arranged so that a particular item can be found
core_image: 前台抽屉里一本厚册子，一列列名字和号码排得像梯子
scene: 册子摊在台面上，纸边被翻得起了毛。 He found the number in the telephone directory.
sceneCN: 这里 directory 指「名录」（第 1 个义项：按顺序排列的名单册）；句意是他在电话簿里查到了那个号码。

senses.title: A book of names and numbers
senses.definition: a book or list that gives names, addresses or telephone numbers in order
senses.definitionCN: 按顺序列出姓名、地址或电话的册子或清单
senses.example: He found the number in the telephone directory.
senses.exampleCN: 他在电话簿里查到了那个号码。
senses.why: A town full of strangers becomes findable once the names are set in rows.
senses.whyCN: 一城陌生人，只要名字排成行，就变得可以找到了。

senses.title: An index of stored items
senses.definition: a list that shows where things are kept or how they are arranged
senses.definitionCN: 标明东西存放位置或排列方式的清单
senses.example: The directory at the back of the report lists every table.
senses.exampleCN: 报告末尾的目录列出了每一张表。
senses.why: The list does not hold the thing, only the way to reach it.
senses.whyCN: 这份清单不装着东西，只装着找到东西的路。

senses.title: A folder on a computer
senses.definition: a named area on a computer that holds files and other folders
senses.definitionCN: 电脑里存放文件与其他文件夹的有名空间
senses.example: Save the pictures in a separate directory.
senses.exampleCN: 把这些图片存到另一个文件夹里。
senses.why: The paper list became a room, and the room can hold rooms inside it.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的清单变成了一间屋子，而屋子还能再装屋子。

intro.en: Directory began as a medieval Latin directorium, a guide or book of rules, and only later became a list of names.
intro.cn: directory 原是中世纪拉丁语 directorium，指指南或规则手册，后来才变成名单。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set straight and to guide a course.
items.cn: dirigere 指拉直，也指引导方向。

items.en: Directorium named a guide or a book that told people what to do.
items.cn: directorium 指指南，或告诉人该怎么做的书。

items.en: English directory first meant a set of directions or rules.
items.cn: 英语里的 directory 最初指一套指示或规则。

items.en: The word shifted to a book of names, addresses and numbers.
items.cn: 这个词转而指收录姓名、地址与号码的册子。

items.en: Computing added the sense of a folder that lists files.
items.cn: 计算机又给它添了「列出文件的文件夹」这一义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct- stem, while the meaning group names other ordered lists.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他有序的清单。

entries.definition: to guide a course or to aim something straight
entries.definitionCN: 指引方向或把某物对准

entries.definition: the line along which someone or something moves
entries.definitionCN: 人或物移动所沿的路线

entries.definition: a person who controls how a film is made
entries.definitionCN: 掌管电影拍摄的人

entries.definition: an ordered list that points to where information is found
entries.definitionCN: 指向信息所在位置的有序清单

entries.definition: a list of goods or items arranged for reference
entries.definitionCN: 供查阅而编排的货品或条目清单

entries.definition: a published list of names, events or properties
entries.definitionCN: 公布出来的名单、活动或房产清单

normalIntro.en: These hooks run from a thick book of names to a folder that holds other folders.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一本厚厚的名单册，走到能装下其他文件夹的文件夹。

normal.en: Direct plus -ory is a place where things are set in order.
normal.cn: direct 加 -ory，就是把东西排整齐的地方。

normal.en: A telephone directory turns a city into rows of names.
normal.cn: 电话簿把一座城变成一排排名字。

normal.en: A directory never holds the thing, only its address.
normal.cn: 名录从不装着东西，只装着它的地址。

normal.en: On a computer, a directory is a folder with a name.
normal.cn: 在电脑里，directory 就是有名字的文件夹。

normal.en: Look up the name, then follow the number.
normal.cn: 先查名字，再顺着号码找过去。

abstract.en: Picture a finger sliding down a column of names.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指沿着一列名字往下滑。

abstract.en: Picture a page thin enough to show the print from behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一页薄纸，背面的字都透了过来。

abstract.en: Picture a folder opening to show smaller folders inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一个文件夹打开，里面还有更小的文件夹。

examples.en: The library keeps a directory of local clubs.
examples.cn: 图书馆存着一份本地社团名录。

examples.en: She searched the directory for his office number.
examples.cn: 她在名录里查他办公室的号码。

examples.en: Copy the file into the main directory.
examples.cn: 把这个文件复制到主文件夹里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 directory 记成「的名字全录」：direct 是排直，-ory 是地方，把名字排直放好的地方就是名录。

root: 来自拉丁语 dirigere（拉直、指引）的名词形式 directorium，本指指南或规则手册。英语先用它表示指示与规则，十八世纪后转向姓名地址录，计算机时代又用来指存放文件的文件夹。

sensesIntro.en: From a printed book of names, to an index of stored things, to a folder on a screen.
sensesIntro.cn: 从印着名字的册子，到存放物品的索引，再到屏幕上的文件夹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick book of names set in straight rows.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本厚册子，名字排成笔直的行。

chain: THE NAMES ARE COPIED IN ORDER
A COMPUTER KEEPS ITS OWN LIST
FILES SIT INSIDE A NAMED SPACE

branches.en: The first sense is the printed book of names and numbers.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是那本印着姓名与号码的册子。

branches.en: The second sense narrows the book to a guide of places.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把这本书收窄成指路的清单。

branches.en: The third sense gives the list a room inside a machine.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这份清单搬进机器里的一间屋子。

branches.en: A book and an index both answer one question: where is it.
branches.cn: 册子和索引都在回答同一个问题：它在哪儿。

branches.en: Both arrange hidden things so that one search finds them.
branches.cn: 两者都把藏着的东西排好，让一次查找就能找到。

intro.en: Directory belongs to the direct- family, words about straight lines and guidance.
intro.cn: directory 属于 direct 一族词，围绕直线与指引。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base dirigere, to set straight, yields direct-, seen in direct, direction and directory.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基 dirigere（拉直）给出 direct，见于 direct、direction 与 directory。

items.meaning: a place or book that keeps things in order
items.example: The directory lists every member of the club.
items.exampleCN: 这份名录列出了俱乐部的每位成员。

items.example: He directed us to the nearest station.
items.exampleCN: 他给我们指了最近的车站。

items.meaning: the line along which something moves
items.example: She walked in the direction of the river.
The director smiled at the finished scene.
items.exampleCN: 导演看着拍完的这场戏笑了。

items.example: The directive was short and firm.

items.meaning: in a straight line or with nothing between
items.example: The road runs directly to the coast.

items.meaning: not straight or not stated openly
items.example: Her reply was polite but indirect.

items.meaning: to send or aim something wrongly
items.example: A wrong label misdirected the parcel.
items.exampleCN: 一个错误的标签把包裹送错了地方。

definition_zh: 解雇；不予考虑；让…离开
definition_en: to remove someone from a job, or to refuse to consider an idea
core_image: 一扇门被推开，里面的人抱着纸箱走出来
scene: 办公室的门开了一下，他抱着纸箱走出来。 The manager dismissed two workers without warning.
sceneCN: 这里 dismiss 指「解雇」（第 1 个义项：让人失去工作）；句意是经理毫无预警地解雇了两名工人。

collocations.zh: 把某人当成空想家而不予理会

senses.title: To send someone from a job
senses.definition: to remove someone from a job or a position
senses.definitionCN: 使某人失去工作或职位
senses.example: The manager dismissed two workers.
senses.exampleCN: 经理解雇了两名工人。
senses.why: A desk is cleared in minutes, a name in seconds.
senses.whyCN: 桌子几分钟就清空，名字几秒就被划掉。

senses.title: To refuse to consider
senses.definition: to decide that something is not worth thinking about
senses.definitionCN: 认定某事不值得考虑
senses.example: He dismissed the warning as a joke.
senses.exampleCN: 他把警告当成玩笑不理。
senses.why: The fastest way to lose an idea is to call it small.
senses.whyCN: 弄丢一个想法最快的办法，是说它太小。

senses.title: To let people leave
senses.definition: to allow a group to leave or to end a gathering
senses.definitionCN: 允许一群人离开或结束聚会
senses.example: The teacher dismissed the class early.
senses.exampleCN: 老师提前下课。
senses.why: A wave of the hand can empty a room politely.
senses.whyCN: 一挥手，就能礼貌地清空一间屋子。

intro.en: Dismiss comes from Latin dimittere, to send away, made of dis-, apart, and mittere, to send.
intro.cn: dismiss 来自拉丁语 dimittere（遣散），由 dis-（分开）与 mittere（送）构成。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or to let go.
items.cn: mittere 指送出或放开。

items.en: Dimittere meant to send people away in different directions.
items.cn: dimittere 指把人往各处遣散。

items.en: Desmettre meant to put away or release.
items.cn: 古法语 desmettre 指放走、解除。

items.en: English dismiss meant to send away a crowd.
items.cn: 英语 dismiss 指遣散一群人。

items.en: The sense of removing from a post became common.
items.cn: 免职这一义在十九世纪通行。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dismiss stem, and the meaning group names other ways of pushing someone out.
note.cn: 形近组共享 dismiss 词干，近义组列出别的把人推开的方式。

entries.definition: the act of removing someone
entries.definitionCN: 解除某人职位的行为

entries.definition: showing that something is not worth attention
entries.definitionCN: 显出不屑一顾的

entries.definition: removed from a post or team
entries.definitionCN: 被解除职位或除名的

entries.definition: to make someone leave a job
entries.definitionCN: 让人离开工作岗位

entries.definition: to refuse to accept an idea or a plan
entries.definitionCN: 拒绝接受想法或计划

entries.definition: to release someone from duty
entries.definitionCN: 解除某人的职务

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a box carried out of a door and end with a closed case.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从抱着纸箱出门开始，落到一件被了结的事。

normal.en: Dis- plus miss: send the person away.
normal.cn: dis 加 miss，把人送走。

normal.en: A dismissed worker keeps the key for one more hour.
normal.cn: 被解雇的工人还能拿着钥匙一小时。

normal.en: To dismiss a warning is to lend it a later voice.
normal.cn: 把警告打发掉，等于留给它更大的声音。

normal.en: The bell dismisses a class faster than any sentence.
normal.cn: 铃声比任何一句话都能更快地下课。

normal.en: A case dismissed is not a case forgotten.
normal.cn: 被驳回的案子，不等于被忘记。

abstract.en: Picture a box carried out in both arms.
abstract.cn: 想象一只纸箱被两只手抱出去。

abstract.en: Picture a hand waved toward the open door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手朝开着的门挥了挥。

abstract.en: Picture a file closed with one flat palm.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌把档案合上。

examples.en: The manager dismissed two workers without warning.
examples.cn: 经理毫无预警地解雇了两名工人。

examples.en: She dismissed the rumour with a short laugh.
examples.cn: 她笑了一声就把那个传闻打发了。

examples.en: The class was dismissed ten minutes early.
examples.cn: 全班提前十分钟下课。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dismiss 记成「送走」：dis 是分开，miss 是送，把人往各处送走就是解散；把人从位子上送走就是解雇。

root: 源自拉丁语 dimittere（遣散），由 dis-（分开）与 mittere（送、放）构成，经古法语 desmettre 进入英语。本义是让一群人各自散去，后来引申为解除职位，再引申为把一个想法或案子打发掉。

sensesIntro.en: From sending a crowd home to sending an idea out of the room.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把一群人送回家，到把一个想法赶出屋子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door opened and a box carried out in both arms.
core.cn: 核心意象：门开了，一只纸箱被双手抱出去。

chain: A NAME IS ON THE LIST

branches.en: The first sense is a person sent from a post.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一个人被从职位上送走。

branches.en: The second sense sends an idea away instead.
branches.cn: 第二个义项送走的是一个想法。

branches.en: The third sense sends a whole group home.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一整群人送回家。

branches.en: All three senses share one gesture of sending away.
branches.cn: 三个义项共有一个「送走」的动作。

branches.en: Both can be done politely, with a word and a nod.
branches.cn: 第一个与第三个义项都能礼貌地完成。

intro.en: Dismiss belongs to the Latin mittere family, where sending and letting go share one stem.
intro.cn: dismiss 属于拉丁语 mittere 一族，送出与放走共用同一词干。

latinIntro.en: Latin mittere, to send, gives dimittere and then dismiss, with dis- marking the sending apart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mittere（送）给出 dimittere，再成为 dismiss，前缀 dis- 标出「分送各处」。

items.exampleCN: 他的解雇通知寄了封信来。

items.example: He spoke dismissively of the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他轻蔑地谈起这个计划。

items.meaning: in the act of sending away
able to be removed from a post
items.example: The post was not dismissible at will.
items.exampleCN: 这个职位不能随意解职。

items.meaning: a sending out with a purpose

definition_zh: 挑选；选拔；精选的
definition_en: to choose from a group by thinking carefully about which is best
core_image: 站在货架前伸出的手，在一排物品中点住一个
scene: 教练在训练场来回踱步，反复端详。 The coach will select six players for the national team.
sceneCN: 这里 select 是「选拔」（第 2 个义项：从多人中慎重选出）；句意是教练将为国家队挑选六名球员。

derivatives.zh: select 加 -ion 名词后缀，义为「选择；选集」
select 加 -ive 形容词后缀，义为「选择的；挑剔的」
select 加 -or 名词后缀，义为「选择者；选择器」

senses.title: To choose one from many
senses.definition: to pick out one or more items from a larger group
senses.definitionCN: 从较大的一组中挑出一个或几个
senses.example: Please select your language on the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 请在屏幕上选择你的语言。
senses.why: The hand hovers, compares, and finally rests on one item.
senses.whyCN: 手悬停、比较，最终停在某一件上。

senses.title: To pick people for a role
senses.definition: to choose people for a job, team, or honor
senses.definitionCN: 为职务、队伍或荣誉挑选人
senses.example: She was selected to lead the project.
senses.exampleCN: 她被选中领导这个项目。
senses.why: The hand now points at a person, not a thing.
senses.whyCN: 这一次手指向的是人，不是物。

senses.title: To set apart as best quality
senses.definition: chosen carefully as being of high quality
senses.definitionCN: 经精心挑选的高品质事物
senses.example: The shop sells select teas from Yunnan.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店出售云南精选茶叶。
senses.why: What the hand picked once now stands apart as the best shelf.
senses.whyCN: 被手挑过的东西，如今单独摆上了最好的货架。

senses.title: To isolate with care
senses.definition: to treat or affect only chosen parts
senses.definitionCN: 只针对选定的部分处理或作用
senses.example: The drug selectively kills cancer cells.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药有选择地杀死癌细胞。
senses.why: The hand touches only the marked ones and leaves the rest.
senses.whyCN: 手只触碰标记过的人，其余一概不碰。

senses.title: To determine by choice
senses.definition: to be decided by someone's act of choosing
senses.definitionCN: 由某人的选择行为决定
senses.example: Your grade is selected by your own effort.
senses.exampleCN: 你的成绩由你自己的努力决定。
senses.why: The shelf ends up shaped by where the hand once pointed.
senses.whyCN: 货架最终的样子，取决于手曾经指向哪里。

intro.en: From Latin seligere, built on se- (apart) and legere (to gather, pick).
intro.cn: 来自拉丁语 seligere，由 se-（分开）与 legere（收集、挑选）构成。

items.en: The root *leg- means to gather or collect, shared with lecture and legal.
items.cn: 词根 *leg- 意为「收集」，也与 lecture、legal 同源。

items.en: Seligere means to pick out separately, se- adding the idea of apartness.
items.cn: 拉丁语 seligere 意为「挑出」，前缀 se- 增加「分离」之意。

items.en: The participle selectus became the adjective form in Romance languages.
items.cn: 过去分词 selectus 在罗曼语中转为形容词形式。

items.en: English took the word from Latin selectus in the 1500s.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪直接借入拉丁语 selectus。

items.en: Modern select covers choosing, selecting people, and premium goods.
items.cn: 现代 select 涵盖挑选、选人与精选商品。

note.en: Look-alikes in the -lect family, and near rivals in the choosing field.
note.cn: -lect 词族的形近词，以及「选择」义场的近义词。

entries.definition: to gather things together
entries.definitionCN: 收集——同根反方向：collect 收拢，select 挑出

entries.definition: to choose by voting
entries.definitionCN: 选举——同根，elect 强调投票

entries.definition: to fail to care for
entries.definitionCN: 忽视——同根负向：neglect 是「不挑不管」

entries.definition: to take what you prefer
entries.definitionCN: 选择——本族词，泛指一切选择

entries.definition: to choose casually or quickly
entries.definitionCN: 挑——口语随意，select 更慎重

entries.definition: to make a choice between options
entries.definitionCN: 选择——强调在选项间抉择

normalIntro.en: Hooks on the -lect family and the hovering hand.
normalIntro.cn: 基于 -lect 词族与悬停之手的记忆钩子。

normal.en: se- apart + lect gather: gather apart, that is select
normal.cn: se-（分开）+ lect（收集）：分开来收，就是挑选

normal.en: elect votes, collect gathers, select picks
normal.cn: elect 投票选，collect 收集，select 精挑

normal.en: selection is the noun, selective is the picky adjective
normal.cn: selection 是名词，selective 是挑剔的形容词

normal.en: a select club admits only the chosen few
normal.cn: a select club 只收被选中的少数人

normal.en: randomly select still uses the careful hand, just blindfolded
normal.cn: randomly select 仍是那只手，只是蒙了眼

abstract.en: Picture a finger hovering over a keyboard of choices
abstract.cn: 想象手指悬停在一排选项按键上

abstract.en: See a hand moving along a shelf, pausing, lifting one jar
abstract.cn: 看见手沿货架移动，停住，拿起一只罐子

abstract.en: Feel the pride of being the one picked out
abstract.cn: 体会被挑中那一刻的自豪

examples.en: You can select three dishes from the set menu.
examples.cn: 你可以从套餐菜单中选三道菜。

examples.en: The committee selected her design for the new bridge.
examples.cn: 委员会选中了她的新桥设计方案。

examples.en: Only a select few were invited to the dinner.
examples.cn: 只有少数精英获邀出席晚宴。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「洗来客特」——挑选像洗菜一样仔细，把来的客人一个个特挑出来。

root: 拉丁语 se-（分开）+ legere（收集、挑选，同根词还有 elect、collect、lecture）构成 seligere「挑出来」；过去分词 selectus 经拉丁语直接进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: One pointing hand, five gestures: picking things, choosing people, marking the premium shelf, touching only some, deciding the outcome.
sensesIntro.cn: 一只指点之手，五种手势：挑物、选人、标注精品架、只碰少数、决定结果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand hovering over a row, pointing at one
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手悬停在一排物品上方，点住一个

branches.en: the basic act of picking one item out
branches.cn: 从一排中挑出一件的基本动作

branches.en: the same hand choosing a person instead
branches.cn: 同一只手指向了人

branches.en: the chosen ones standing on a special shelf
branches.cn: 被选中的摆上特殊货架

branches.en: touching only the marked, sparing the rest
branches.cn: 只碰被标记的，放过其余

branches.en: one gesture covers goods and people alike
branches.cn: 同一动作涵盖物与人

intro.en: Words built on the Latin -lect root of gathering and picking.
intro.cn: 由拉丁 -lect「收集、挑选」词根构成的英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives sharing legere.
latinIntro.cn: 共享 legere 词根的拉丁同族词。

items.meaning: the act or result of choosing

items.exampleCN: 这所学校选拔非常严格。

definition_zh: 朝向；对于；接近；有助于
definition_en: in the direction of, or close to a point in time or amount
core_image: 箭头指向目标：方向感藏在每一步里
scene: 小猫朝着窗边阳光慢慢走去： The cat walked slowly towards the sunny window.
sceneCN: 这里 toward 是「朝向」（第 1 个义项：表示方向）；句意是小猫慢慢走向洒满阳光的窗户。

derivatives.zh: 由 home 加 -ward 构成，与 toward 同用 -ward 方向后缀，义为「向家的；归途的」
由 fore 加 -ward 构成，同用方向后缀 -ward，义为「向前」
由 up 加 -ward 构成，同用方向后缀 -ward，义为「向上」

senses.title: In the direction of
senses.definition: in the direction that leads to a place or person
senses.definitionCN: 朝向某个地点或人物的方向
senses.example: She walked towards the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她朝车站走去。
senses.why: The core image of an arrow fixed on a target is the pure directional sense.
senses.whyCN: 箭头锁定目标的核心意象，就是最纯粹的方位义。

senses.title: With regard to
senses.definition: showing a feeling or attitude directed at someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 表示针对某人某物的情感或态度
senses.example: His attitude towards the new plan is positive.
senses.exampleCN: 他对新计划持积极态度。
senses.why: Direction in space turns into direction of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 空间的方向转为情感指向的方向。

senses.title: Close to in time or amount
senses.definition: approaching a particular time, age, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 临近某个时间、年龄或数量
senses.example: He is getting richer towards fifty.
senses.exampleCN: 快到五十岁时他越来越富有。
senses.why: Movement toward a point also applies to points in time.
senses.whyCN: 朝某点的移动同样适用于时间轴上的点。

senses.title: Contributing to
senses.titleCN: 有助于；用于（目标或款项）
senses.definition: contributing money or effort to a purpose or fund
senses.definitionCN: 为某目标或款项出资出力
senses.example: They saved money towards a new car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们攒钱准备买辆新车。
senses.why: Effort travels toward a goal just as a body travels toward a place.
senses.whyCN: 努力朝目标移动，正如身体朝地点移动。

intro.en: Toward is Old English to + weard, 'turned to', a compound of facing and direction.
intro.cn: toward 由古英语 to + weard（转向）构成，是「面向」与「方向」的复合词。

items.en: *Warthuza meant 'turning toward, facing'.
items.cn: 日耳曼重构形 *warthuza 意为「转向、面对」。

items.en: To weard meant 'in the direction of', written as two words.
items.cn: 古英语 to weard 意为「朝……方向」，写作两词。

items.en: Toward and towards both appear, meanings identical.
items.cn: 中古英语 toward 与 towards 并存，意义相同。

items.en: American English prefers toward; British English prefers towards.
items.cn: 美式英语偏好 toward，英式偏好 towards。

items.en: The -ward element also lives in forward, backward, homeward.
items.cn: -ward 成分也见于 forward、backward、homeward。

note.en: Words close to toward in form, and direction words of the same family.
note.cn: 与 toward 形近的词及同词族的方向词。

entries.definition: directed toward home
entries.definitionCN: 同用 -ward 方向后缀的词，义为「向家的；归途的」

entries.definition: to the front; ahead
entries.definitionCN: 向前，同用 -ward 后缀

entries.definition: a tall building
entries.definitionCN: 塔，与 toward 拼写重叠但词源无关（源自拉丁 turris）

entries.definition: a prize given
entries.definitionCN: 奖项，拼写近似而词源不同（源自拉丁 ad + wardare）

entries.definition: reaching a destination
entries.definitionCN: 到；向，强调抵达，toward 只表方向不表到达

entries.definition: entering inside
entries.definitionCN: 进入，强调进入内部

entries.definition: in opposition to
entries.definitionCN: 反对；逆着，态度方向与 toward 相反

entries.definition: moving in the opposite direction
entries.definitionCN: 远离，方向与 toward 相反

normalIntro.en: Keep the arrow picture and the -ward family together.
normalIntro.cn: 把箭头画面和 -ward 词族绑在一起记。

normal.en: toward = to + ward, turned toward
normal.cn: toward ＝ to（向）+ ward（转），面向目标

normal.en: -ward words: forward, backward, homeward
normal.cn: -ward 词族：forward（向前）、backward（向后）、homeward（归家方向）

normal.en: toward evening = near evening
normal.cn: toward evening 指临近傍晚，方向用于时间

normal.en: money toward a goal = saving for it
normal.cn: money toward a goal 指为目标攒的钱

normal.en: US spelling toward, UK spelling towards
normal.cn: 美式拼 toward，英式拼 towards

abstract.en: See an arrow never quite landing
abstract.cn: 看一支永远差一步未落地的箭，正是「朝向」

abstract.en: Feel feelings flowing like currents toward someone
abstract.cn: 感受情感如水流般流向某人

abstract.en: Watch a calendar page flip closer to the marked date
abstract.cn: 看日历一页页翻近标记的日期

examples.en: The ship headed towards the open sea.
examples.cn: 船朝开阔的大海驶去。

examples.en: Public anger towards the policy kept growing.
examples.cn: 公众对该政策的不满持续增长。

examples.en: Every dollar goes towards rebuilding the school.
examples.cn: 每一美元都用于重建学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特沃德」——特别向我方（ward 有「守卫」联想）靠近：特沃德，正朝我来。

root: 古英语 to（向）+ weard（转向、面向，日耳曼语族），本义「朝向某面」。-ward 后缀的亲戚遍布方向词：forward、backward、upward 等皆同源。

sensesIntro.en: One facing compound points arrows, feelings, dates, and savings at their targets.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「面向」复合词，把箭头、情感、日期与存款都指向各自目标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow pointed but not yet landed
core.cn: 核心意象：指向目标却尚未落地的箭

branches.en: bodies moving through space
branches.cn: 在空间中移动的身体

branches.en: feelings aimed at people
branches.cn: 指向他人的情感

branches.en: time and totals in motion
branches.cn: 移动中的时间与数量

branches.en: effort banked toward goals
branches.cn: 存向目标的努力

branches.en: one direction, space or time
branches.cn: 同一个方向，在空间或时间轴上

intro.en: Toward lives in the productive -ward family of native direction words.
intro.cn: toward 属于能产的 -ward 本土方向词族。

latinIntro.en: Being Germanic, toward has no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼词，toward 没有拉丁同族词。

items.meaningCN: 塔，与 toward 拼写重叠而词源无关

definition_zh: 洗涤槽；水槽；水池；下沉
definition_en: a basin with a tap, or to go down below a surface
core_image: 厨房水槽里堆着碗，水面慢慢退去
scene: 厨房的水槽里堆满了碗。 The sink in the kitchen was full of bowls.
sceneCN: 这里 sink 是「水槽」（第 1 个义项）；句意：厨房的水槽里堆满了碗。

senses.title: A basin with a tap
senses.definition: a fixed basin for washing, with a water supply
senses.definitionCN: 带供水装置、用于洗涤的固定盆
senses.example: The sink in the kitchen was full of bowls.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房的水槽里堆满了碗。
senses.why: This is the everyday object sense of the noun.
senses.whyCN: 这是名词最日常的物件义项。

senses.title: To go under water
senses.definition: to go down below the surface of water
senses.definitionCN: 沉到水面以下
senses.example: The boat began to sink in the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 船在风暴中开始下沉。
senses.why: This is the old verb sense behind the noun.
senses.whyCN: 这是名词背后古老的动词义项。

senses.title: To fall or slope down
senses.definition: to move downward slowly
senses.definitionCN: 缓慢向下移动
senses.example: He sank into the soft chair.
senses.exampleCN: 他陷进柔软的椅子里。
senses.why: The body can sink as a boat does.
senses.whyCN: 身体也能像船一样下沉。

senses.title: To become lower
senses.definition: to fall to a lower level or amount
senses.definitionCN: 降到更低的水平或数量
senses.example: Prices sank after the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 收获之后价格下降了。
senses.why: Numbers go down like objects under water.
senses.whyCN: 数字下降就像物体沉入水中。

intro.en: Sink began as a verb, and the noun for a basin came later.
intro.cn: sink 最初是动词，表示水槽的名词用法出现较晚。

items.en: Sincan meant to go down.
items.cn: sincan 意为向下沉。

items.en: Sank and sunken were its old forms.
items.cn: sank 和 sunken 是它的古老形式。

items.en: Sinken meant to go under water.
items.cn: sinken 意为沉入水中。

items.en: The noun sink named a basin fixed in place.
items.cn: 名词 sink 指固定安装的盆。

items.en: It also means to fall in price.
items.cn: 它也表示为价格下跌。

note.en: Sink is compared with similar-looking words and words for going down.
note.cn: 把 sink 与形近词以及表示下降的词作比较。

entries.definitionCN: 下降

abstract.cn: 水槽留住水，石头让水离开。

abstract.en: What sinks may still be raised.

abstract.cn: 寂静能像水一样渗进房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: sink 的变化是 sink-sank-sunk；名词「水槽」正是让水「沉下去排走」的地方。

root: 源自古英语 sincan（下沉）；名词「水槽」由「让水沉下排走」的功能引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: Sink means a washing basin or to go down below a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: sink 意为洗涤水槽，或下沉到表面以下。

core.en: Going down, or the place where water goes down.
core.cn: 向下沉降，或让水流下去的地方。

branches.en: Bowls fill the basin by the tap.
branches.cn: 水龙头旁的盆里堆满碗。

branches.en: A boat goes under the waves.
branches.cn: 船没入浪下。

branches.en: A body settles into a soft chair.
branches.cn: 身体陷进软椅。

branches.en: A price line moves downward.
branches.cn: 价格曲线向下移动。

branches.en: The basin and the boat share the idea of water going down.
branches.cn: 水槽与船都共享「水向下」的意象。

intro.en: Sink builds words for sunken things and weights.
intro.cn: sink 构成表示沉没之物与坠物的词。

latinIntro.en: Sink is Old English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: sink 是古英语词，并非拉丁语。

items.meaningCN: 水槽；下沉（第三人称单数）
items.example: The old house has two sinks.
items.exampleCN: 这所老房子有两个水槽。

items.example: The sinking boat sent a signal.
items.exampleCN: 正在下沉的船发出了信号。

items.example: The news took time to sink in.
items.exampleCN: 这个消息过了一阵才被理解。
